question: Bahauddin Dagar is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rudra Veena__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bahauddin Dagar is associated with **Rudra Veena**.
 
• He was the son of famous **north Indian musician Zia Mohiuddin Dagar.**
 
• He plays Rudra vena in the dagarbani style. 
 
• He was awarded the highest award for performing artists, **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ronu Mazumdar is a well-known **exponent of** the flute Musical Instrument.**
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan Bangash **is the exponent of Sarod.
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar **is a Well-known exponent of Sitar.
